$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for god powers. All powers are reusable: first cast free, then baseFavorCost, ramping +costRampPercent% per recast (KICKOFF §6). Durations/cooldowns in seconds, radii/ranges in tiles, damage in human-readable points (divine ignores armor).

solar_lance.name: Solar Lance
solar_lance.description: A spear of concentrated sunlight strikes a point, dealing divine damage in a small radius.

golden_flood.name: Golden Flood
golden_flood.description: Ripened light floods the fields: farm and forage income doubled for the duration.

pyre_storm.name: Pyre Storm
pyre_storm.description: A storm of falling embers scours an area for several seconds.

searing_mirage.name: Searing Mirage
searing_mirage.description: Heat-haze blinds enemies in the area: their range units miss half their shots and lose half their sight.

risen_champion.name: Risen Champion
risen_champion.description: Summons an empowered Radiant Champion from the pyre-light for a limited time.

aegis_of_dawn.name: Aegis of Dawn
aegis_of_dawn.description: A golden shield of first light renders buildings in the area invulnerable for the duration.

lure_of_tides.name: Lure of Tides
lure_of_tides.description: Places a shimmering lure: nearby game drifts toward it and fish school in adjacent waters.

cleansing_rain.name: Cleansing Rain
cleansing_rain.description: Soft rain heals friendly units in the area and washes away burns and petrification.

floodsurge.name: Floodsurge
floodsurge.description: A wall of water surges down a line, dealing crush damage and scattering formations.

mistveil.name: Mistveil
mistveil.description: Dense sea-mist conceals friendly units in the area from enemy sight.

maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
maelstrom.description: A churning vortex drags enemies inward, grinding them with divine damage.

kelpward.name: Kelpward
kelpward.description: Grasping kelp erupts from the earth, rooting enemy units in place.

ironhide.name: Ironhide
ironhide.description: Skin turns to tempered iron: friendly units in the area gain +15% to all armor.

flaming_weapons.name: Flaming Weapons
flaming_weapons.description: Every friendly soldier's weapon ignites, adding divine damage to each strike.

vajra_bolt.name: Vajra Bolt
vajra_bolt.description: A forged thunderbolt annihilates a single target and arcs to nearby enemies.

forge_quake.name: Forge-Quake
forge_quake.description: The ground hammers like an anvil: heavy crush damage, devastating to buildings.

call_of_the_last_war.name: Call of the Last War
call_of_the_last_war.description: Villagers take up ancestral arms, fighting as Forgeborn heroes for the duration.

molten_rampart.name: Molten Rampart
molten_rampart.description: A rampart of cooling magma rises along a line, burning anything that touches it.

clarity.name: Clarity
clarity.description: The clouds part: the entire map is revealed for the duration.

crosswinds.name: Crosswinds
crosswinds.description: A following wind fills friendly banners: units in the area move half again as fast.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.description: Driving hail and gale-force wind batter an area, slowing and shredding enemies.

mirrored_skies.name: Mirrored Skies
mirrored_skies.description: Conjures an illusory mirror of a selected army — convincing, but harmless.

tricksters_gift.name: Trickster's Gift
tricksters_gift.description: A whispered bargain turns one enemy unit to your banner, permanently.

sovereign_bolt.name: Sovereign Bolt
sovereign_bolt.description: The king-bolt of the high sky executes a single target and staggers everything nearby.
